notes: Mechanical and thermal values are from Bambu Lab's filament guide (bambulab.com/en/filament/guide), tested on printed coupons. PA6 (unfilled) keeps estimated values.
The raw Bambu data is in data/bambu-reference.json (41 filaments). The bambu object inside each material document carries the original fields.
Shrinkage % is the value for the Bambu/Orca filament profile (100 = no compensation).
Specific stiffness = E (MPa) / UTS (MPa). Higher reaches its strength limit with less deflection.
Support ratings: Good = reliable breakaway or dissolvable pairing. OK = works with tuning or an interface layer. No = bonds too well or process windows do not overlap.
PLA is No against anything needing a heated chamber. PVA degrades above roughly 250°C.
Same-material support (PETG on PETG) fuses and is the classic mistake.
elongation_at_break_pct, curve_class and the process windows of support-only materials (HIPS, PVA, BVOH, PA/PET support) are typical values added for charting, not measured data.
PA6 (Nylon), PA6-GF and PPA-CF were added from typical datasheet values, not the original sheet. Dry nylon numbers: properties fall noticeably once the filament or part takes on moisture.
Stiffness rank and heat rank are worked out from the numbers on load, so they update as materials are added.
